model.name: gpt-oss-120b
model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (117B, 5.1B active), MXFP4 as released; the larger sibling of the approved 20b. Fits one 80 GB card. Measured on 2026-09-26 with the original harness (eval/RESULTS.md): same answers as the 20b on the twelve original questions, more than twice the GPU time per question, and no wrong draft on the stripped catalog where the 20b made one.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    dc.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel dc
  ON fat.channel_key = dc.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fat.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dc.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND is_active = TRUE;

SELECT
    dj.display_name AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert faa
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction dj
  ON faa.jurisdiction_key = dj.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON faa.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dj.display_name
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    b.branch_key,
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch AS b
  ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY b.branch_key, b.display_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
    dcc.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dcc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dcc.complaint_category_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND dcc.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY dcc.display_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    dc.currency_code,
    AVG(fr.average_rate) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily fr
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fr.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency dc ON fr.currency_key = dc.currency_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fr.average_rate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dc.currency_code
ORDER BY dc.currency_code;

SELECT
    dm.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(fpv.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily fpv
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market dm ON fpv.market_key = dm.market_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fpv.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dm.display_name
ORDER BY dm.display_name;

SELECT
    account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.dim_account
WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY account_type_code
ORDER BY account_type_code;

SELECT
    b.city_name AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY b.city_name
ORDER BY b.city_name;

SELECT AVG(fab.closing_balance_amount) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily fab
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fab.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(fx.mid_rate) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily fx
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fx.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fx.currency_code = 'USD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.month_number = 12;

SELECT d.month_number AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fcd
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date d
       ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE  d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP  BY d.month_number
ORDER  BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    dc.customer_segment_code AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
WHERE dc.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY dc.customer_segment_code
ORDER BY dc.customer_segment_code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS customers_without_transactions_2025
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE fat.customer_key = c.customer_key
      AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
);

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    dcc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dcc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = dcc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE fc.is_escalated = TRUE
  AND dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dcc.display_name
ORDER BY dcc.display_name;

SELECT dc.display_name AS channel_name,
       SUM(fat.fee_amount) AS total_fees_2025
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction AS fat
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date AS dd
       ON fat.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_channel AS dc
       ON fat.channel_key = dc.channel_key
WHERE  dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP  BY dc.display_name
ORDER  BY dc.display_name;

SELECT SUM(fcd.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute AS fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fcd.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
  dj.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert faa
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON faa.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction dj
  ON faa.jurisdiction_key = dj.jurisdiction_key
WHERE faa.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dj.display_name
ORDER BY dj.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.loan_id) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.days_past_due > 90;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS account_transaction_count
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_channel c
       ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date d
       ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE  c.channel_type_code = 'Mobile App'  -- assuming this code identifies the Mobile App channel
  AND  d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT
    lp.display_name AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(fd.outstanding_principal_amount) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement fd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_loan_product lp
  ON fd.loan_product_key = lp.loan_product_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY lp.display_name
ORDER BY lp.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ft.customer_key) AS distinct_sme_customers_cross_border_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer ft
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer dc ON ft.customer_key = dc.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON ft.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dc.customer_segment_code = 'SME'
  AND ft.is_cross_border = TRUE
  AND dd.calendar_year_number = 2025;

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT f.branch_key,
         b.region_code,
         b.display_name AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    AND b.is_current = TRUE
    AND b.is_active = TRUE
  GROUP BY f.branch_key, b.region_code, b.display_name
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code,
         branch_name,
         atm_txn_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT region_code,
       branch_name,
       atm_txn_cnt AS atm_transactions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    dm.merchant_category_code,
    SUM(fca.original_amount) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fca
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant dm
  ON fca.merchant_key = dm.merchant_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fca.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fca.original_amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dm.merchant_category_code
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    c.business_id,
    SUM(fwt.original_amount) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
  ON fwt.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fwt.original_amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.business_id
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    ft.currency_code AS currency_code,
    SUM(ft.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer ft
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON ft.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY ft.currency_code
ORDER BY ft.currency_code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wt.customer_key) AS distinct_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d_wt ON wt.business_date_key = d_wt.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction at ON at.customer_key = wt.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d_at ON at.business_date_key = d_at.date_key
WHERE d_wt.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d_at.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date d
       ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE  d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP  BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER  BY d.calendar_year_number;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT customer_key,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY business_id ORDER BY effective_from_date DESC, version_number DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
USING ranked r
WHERE dim_customer.customer_key = r.customer_key
  AND r.rn > 1;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.fact_complaint;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily (
    business_date_key,
    currency_code,
    base_currency_code,
    quote_currency_code,
    currency_pair_code,
    rate_type_code,
    effective_date_key,
    mid_rate,
    source_system_code,
    ingested_at,
    updated_at
) SELECT
    d.date_key AS business_date_key,
    'USD'::VARCHAR AS currency_code,
    'USD'::VARCHAR AS base_currency_code,
    'USD'::VARCHAR AS quote_currency_code,
    'USD/USD'::VARCHAR AS currency_pair_code,
    'MID'::VARCHAR AS rate_type_code,
    d.date_key AS effective_date_key,
    1.10::NUMERIC(14,8) AS mid_rate,
    'manual'::VARCHAR AS source_system_code,
    now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS ingested_at,
    now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS updated_at
FROM bank_dwh.dim_date d
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-12-31';

UPDATE bank_dwh.dim_customer
SET customer_segment_code = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE city_name = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND is_current = TRUE;

SELECT dc.currency_code AS currency,
       SUM(fwt.settlement_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency dc ON fwt.currency_key = dc.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fwt.settlement_amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dc.currency_code
ORDER BY dc.currency_code;

SELECT
    dc.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel dc
  ON fat.channel_key = dc.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fat.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dc.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND is_active = TRUE;

SELECT
    dj.display_name AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert faa
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction dj
  ON faa.jurisdiction_key = dj.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON faa.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dj.display_name
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    b.branch_key,
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch AS b
  ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY b.branch_key, b.display_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
    dcc.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dcc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dcc.complaint_category_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND dcc.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY dcc.display_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    dc.currency_code,
    AVG(fr.average_rate) AS avg_daily_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily fr
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fr.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency dc ON fr.currency_key = dc.currency_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fr.average_rate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dc.currency_code
ORDER BY dc.currency_code;

SELECT
  dm.display_name AS market_name,
  SUM(fpv.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily fpv
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market dm
  ON fpv.market_key = dm.market_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fpv.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dm.display_name
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        customer_key,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY business_id ORDER BY version_number DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
USING ranked r
WHERE dim_customer.customer_key = r.customer_key
  AND r.rn > 1;

SELECT
    account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.dim_account
WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY account_type_code
ORDER BY account_type_code;

SELECT
    b.city_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY b.city_name
ORDER BY b.city_name;

SELECT AVG(fab.closing_balance_amount) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily fab
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fab.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(fx.mid_rate) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily fx
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fx.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fx.currency_code = 'USD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.month_number = 12;

SELECT d.month_number AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fcd
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date d
       ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE  d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP  BY d.month_number
ORDER  BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    dc.customer_segment_code AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
WHERE dc.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY dc.customer_segment_code
ORDER BY dc.customer_segment_code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS customers_without_transactions_2025
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
  ON c.customer_key = fat.customer_key
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_date d
    WHERE d.date_key = fat.business_date_key
      AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  )
WHERE fat.account_transaction_fact_key IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    dcc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dcc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = dcc.complaint_category_key
WHERE fc.is_escalated = TRUE
  AND dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dcc.display_name
ORDER BY dcc.display_name;

SELECT dc.display_name AS channel_name,
       SUM(fat.fee_amount) AS total_fees_2025
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction AS fat
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date AS dd
       ON fat.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_channel AS dc
       ON fat.channel_key = dc.channel_key
WHERE  dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP  BY dc.display_name
ORDER  BY dc.display_name;

SELECT SUM(fcd.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute AS fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fcd.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    dj.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert AS fa
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS dd
  ON fa.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction AS dj
  ON fa.jurisdiction_key = dj.jurisdiction_key
WHERE fa.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dj.display_name
ORDER BY dj.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.loan_id) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.days_past_due > 90;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_channel c
       ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date d
       ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE  c.channel_type_code = 'Mobile App'
  AND d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT
    lp.display_name AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(d.outstanding_principal_amount) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_loan_product lp
  ON d.loan_product_key = lp.loan_product_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE dt.calendar_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY lp.display_name
ORDER BY lp.display_name;

SELECT

    SUM(COALESCE(fca.original_amount, 0)) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fca
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fca.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m
  ON fca.merchant_key = m.merchant_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY m.merchant_category_code
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT dc.business_id,
       SUM(fwt.original_amount) AS total_wire_amount
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer AS fwt
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_customer AS dc
       ON fwt.customer_key = dc.customer_key
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date AS dd
       ON fwt.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE  dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP  BY dc.business_id
ORDER  BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    fwt.currency_code AS currency_code,
    SUM(fwt.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer AS fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d
  ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY fwt.currency_code
ORDER BY fwt.currency_code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS distinct_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dwt ON wt.business_date_key = dwt.date_key
    WHERE wt.customer_key = c.customer_key
      AND dwt.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction at
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dat ON at.business_date_key = dat.date_key
    WHERE at.customer_key = c.customer_key
      AND dat.calendar_year_number = 2025
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date d
       ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE  d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP  BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER  BY d.calendar_year_number;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT customer_key,

    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
)

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.fact_complaint;

SELECT

FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency dc ON fwt.currency_key = dc.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fwt.settlement_amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dc.currency_code
ORDER BY dc.currency_code;

SELECT
    dc.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fat.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel dc ON fat.channel_key = dc.channel_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dc.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE

SELECT

FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert faa
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction dj
  ON faa.jurisdiction_key = dj.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON faa.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dj.display_name
ORDER BY aml_alerts_raised DESC;

SELECT
    b.branch_key,
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch AS b
  ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND b.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY b.branch_key, b.display_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact

    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
    dcc.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dcc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dcc.complaint_category_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND dcc.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY dcc.display_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT

JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fr.business_date_key = dd.date_key

WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fr.average_rate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dc.currency_code
ORDER BY dc.currency_code;

SELECT

  SUM(fpv.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily fpv
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market dm

JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fpv.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dm.display_name
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
  ON c.customer_key = fat.customer_key
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bank_dwh.dim_date d
        WHERE d.date_key = fat.business_date_key
          AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
      )
WHERE fat.account_transaction_fact_key IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    dcc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dcc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = dcc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date ddate
  ON fc.business_date_key = ddate.date_key
WHERE fc.is_escalated = TRUE
  AND ddate.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dcc.display_name
ORDER BY dcc.display_name;

SELECT dc.display_name AS channel_name,
       SUM(fat.fee_amount) AS total_fees_2025
FROM   bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction AS fat
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date AS dd
       ON fat.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_channel AS dc
       ON fat.channel_key = dc.channel_key
WHERE  dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP  BY dc.display_name
ORDER  BY dc.display_name;

SELECT SUM(fcd.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute AS fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fcd.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
  dj.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert fa
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fa.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction dj ON fa.jurisdiction_key = dj.jurisdiction_key
WHERE fa.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dj.display_name
ORDER BY dj.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.loan_id) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,

FROM   bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f

SELECT

FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_loan_product lp ON d.loan_product_key = lp.loan_product_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE dt.calendar_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY lp.display_name
ORDER BY lp.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ft.customer_key) AS distinct_sme_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer ft
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer dc ON ft.customer_key = dc.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON ft.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE ft.is_cross_border = TRUE
  AND dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND dc.customer_segment_code = 'SME';

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT f.branch_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
), branch_counts AS (
    SELECT b.region_code,
           b.display_name AS branch_name,
           COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.region_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM atm_2025 a

    WHERE b.is_current = TRUE
    GROUP BY b.region_code, b.display_name
)
SELECT region_code,
       branch_name,
       atm_txn_cnt AS number_of_atm_transactions
FROM branch_counts
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    m.merchant_category_code,

FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fca
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m
  ON fca.merchant_key = m.merchant_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fca.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025

GROUP BY m.merchant_category_code
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.business_id,
  SUM(fwt.original_amount) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
  ON fwt.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fwt.original_amount IS NOT NULL

SELECT

JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d_at ON at.business_date_key = d_at.date_key
WHERE d_wt.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,

FROM   bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN   bank_dwh.dim_date d
       ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE  d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;
